children: SIGNET JEWELERS LTD reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue roughly flat at $1.53B and a return to profitability with diluted EPS of $1.33, compared with a loss in the prior-year quarter — 10-Q Summary.
¹ Reported as “Total sales”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Earnings (loss) per common share”.
Revenue trend: Total sales declined 0.5% year-over-year in Q2, while same-store sales rose 2.2%, driven by strength in bridal and services.
Channel shift: E-commerce sales fell about 5.5% in Q2 following the decommissioning of the James Allen site; online mix decreased to 19.6% of sales.
Brand momentum: Strong same-store growth at Kay, Zales, Jared and the company's UK brands, supported by a mid-single-digit increase in average unit retail (AUR).
Strategic initiatives: Entered year two of the Grow Brand Love strategy with brand relaunches, merchandising refreshes and marketing changes.
Operational actions: Decommissioning of James Allen and Rocksbox sites led to inventory disposals and related restructuring charges during the quarter.
